meta.title: Novel Workbench
meta.description: Novel Workbench: write a long novel in one place — desk, manuscript, decisions, memory, style studio, canon and sources — with a chapter engine, four context segments, style/canon imports and recoverable transactions.

name: Novel Workbench
description: One install for beat / fade / voice / fanfic / conductor: eight novel_* tools, master/project/session switches, original/fanfic modes, style and world imports, all inside a single Novel Workbench page. Adopt legacy ledgers, then uninstall the five separate plugins.
